changed_factors: Set optimizer_convolution_rule=quintic: apply five fixed float32 quintic steps to the augmented matrix [M; optimizer_smoothing I] using coefficients (3.4445, -4.775, 2.0315), then take its top block divided by 1.21. This bounded spectral filter is inspired by Muon but is a different optimizer from native polar/SVD, with no inverse-root convergence or update-equivalence claim. No momentum, rate, precision or weight-decay retuning. Only CUDA per-offset convolution groups with more than 32 channels per group use the new rule. CPU, tiny convolution, dense, bias and sampled-prior paths retain the native laws. Prior learning, SBNP regularization, Born-Infeld critic penalty, thermal behavior, smoothing, all learning rates, momentum, architecture, initialization and sampling remain unchanged.

model_ae_ddgan_bimodal_chain.description: Reconstruct held-out inputs through a learned particle AE and four public DDGAN reverse steps while preserving independent generation and conditional-transition quality

host_definition.training_law: independent D/G clean mixture draws, independent uniform per-row timestep 1..4; public DDGAN.forward_pair; predicted-clean G and public DDGAN.reverse with independent Gaussian eta; public adversarial loss+critic penalty+recipe prior regularization; plus weighted public ParticleEncoding.reconstruction_loss of clean input from G(xt,AE(clean),t); shared encoder query/offset network; bind union of independently sampled and encoded prior rows
host_definition.sampling_law: Public DDGAN [1,.9,.5,.05,.0001]; N(0,I) terminal start; fresh independent learned-MoG latent/kernel noise and Gaussian reverse noise at EVERY step; eight heldout time/observation transition panels; separate paired cohort: encode held-out clean input once, hold its deterministic AE code through all four reverse steps from independent N(0,I), fresh Gaussian reverse noise each step; shuffled-code control shares identical start and reverse noise
host_definition.paired_sampling_law: Held-out clean input encoded once; hold deterministic code through reverse steps 4,3,2,1 from independent N(0,I), fresh Gaussian eta every step; shuffle code rows with identical start and reverse eta

model_vae_categorical.description: Can a genuine particle VAE retain the input and posterior noise while independently generating both target modes? New constrained two-mode seed-0 public-component cohort; does not reproduce or qualify historical 100-mode results. Hard routing has constant log(K) KL and biased straight-through gradients; categorical routing uses the public leave-one-out score estimator and a variable KL. A stochastic no-KL AE is not a VAE.

host_definition.initialization: particlegan.init.deterministic_orthogonal_: E seed0, G seed1, D seed2, prior R2 seed3; isolated constructor scope seed0
host_definition.sampling: Independent uniform learned MoG prior with fixed latent sigma=.025; live decoder means and separate Gaussian likelihood draws G(z)+.03*epsilon. Reconstructions use eight posterior draws with prior-matching local Gaussian noise.
host_definition.objective: GAN + recipe.reconstruction_weight * observation_sigma^2 * public negative_elbo + recipe-owned prior regularization

gate_policy.rationale: Provisional two-mode VAE gate fixed before training; oracle and destructive scorer controls establish scope, not scientific screen calibration.

stopping_rules: Complete all six basic model tasks at their frozen budgets; preserve every failed bound.
Only if every basic model task passes may full Tier2 chain tasks run.
Otherwise Tier2 full runs are BLOCKED; each receives exactly one three-update software-only prefix and actual-training GIF, INCOMPLETE against its unchanged full task.
No seed changes, threshold changes, tuning, continuation or promotion follows.
predictions: AE reconstruction may fit the paired problem without learning the unconditional target; the joint variant must satisfy both.
A genuine VAE must retain input information, correct prior-matching local noise and valid KL/ELBO identities, with independent-prior generation scored separately.
Full DDGAN chains must match all declared conditional transition panels and the final law; direct posterior correctness is insufficient.
AE-DDGAN must preserve both input pairing through four reverse steps and independent chain quality.
falsifier: Any declared numerical bound fails in the five-observation terminal suffix, a full budget is incomplete, or source/recipe/finite-state/RNG/update guards fail.
